title: Getting started: starting weaviate and adding the dependency

cues.en: So, in this section of the course, we're going to add a second vector store.
cues.zh: 這一節會新增第二種向量儲存區。

cues.en: Currently we have one for Postgres, and now we're going to add one for Weaviate.
cues.zh: 目前已經有 Postgres，現在要加入 Weaviate。

cues.en: And Weaviate is, in a lot of cases, for a lot of developers, the go-to vector store for storing vector information.
cues.zh: 對很多開發者和應用情境來說，Weaviate 都是儲存向量資訊時的首選。

cues.en: But, of course, we've used Postgres, and a lot of developers really underestimate just how powerful Postgres is.
cues.zh: 不過我們已經用過 Postgres，很多開發者其實低估了它的強大，

cues.en: It does exactly what we need.
cues.zh: 它完全能滿足需求。

cues.en: But we may as well implement Weaviate as well.
cues.zh: 但我們不妨也實作 Weaviate。

cues.en: It's relatively easy for us to do that, because we've organized our code using that abstract interface we specified over here in base.py.
cues.zh: 這相對容易，因為程式碼已依照 base.py 定義的抽象介面組織好了。

cues.en: Now, if we look at docker-compose, docker-compose.yml, we already have this set up, and we're not
cues.zh: 如果查看 docker-compose.yml，會發現設定早已存在，只是

cues.en: activating it when we run docker-compose up-dash-d, but we can bring it up easily enough.
cues.zh: 執行 docker compose up -d 時不會啟動它，但很容易另外啟動。

cues.en: Let's just open our terminal, and I'll quit it out of what I have running right now, PyRegWatch, and I'll write docker-compose down, because I know I have docker running right now, and
cues.zh: 開啟終端機，先退出目前執行中的 pyrag watch，再執行 docker compose down，因為知道 Docker 正在執行，

cues.en: that brings it down. Okay?
cues.zh: 這會將服務停止。

cues.en: And as the comment says there on line 22 in the docker-compose file, to bring Weaviate
cues.zh: 如 docker-compose 檔第 22 行註解所說，要啟動 Weaviate，

cues.en: up, all I have to do is to type docker-compose dash-dash-profile Weaviate up-dash-d, okay?
cues.zh: 只要輸入 docker compose --profile weaviate up -d，

cues.en: And that will go and pull it for me.
cues.zh: 它就會替我下載。

cues.en: And I need to allow Visual Studio Code to do that, and it will go and find a docker image for Weaviate, and it pulls it, and now it's up and running.
cues.zh: 需要允許 Visual Studio Code 執行，它會找到 Weaviate 的 Docker 映像檔並下載，現在已啟動。

cues.en: So if I look at docker-desktop, the dashboard, you can see that now I have Postgres running and I have Weaviate running, and I'll leave that up and running for right now, okay?
cues.zh: 查看 Docker Desktop 儀表板，可以看到 Postgres 和 Weaviate 都在執行，目前先讓它們繼續。

cues.en: Now, the second thing we have to do is to get the necessary package to support Weaviate in Python.
cues.zh: 第二件事，是取得 Python 支援 Weaviate 所需的套件。

cues.en: So let's go over to pyproject.toml, and here in the dependency section in the project block, I'll add a new line after watchdog, okay?
cues.zh: 到 pyproject.toml，在 project 的 dependencies 裡、watchdog 後面加一行，

cues.en: And it's just Weaviate-client greater than or equal to 4.9, okay?
cues.zh: 就是 weaviate-client，大於等於 4.9，

cues.en: And then my trailing comma.
cues.zh: 後面加逗號。

cues.en: And now that I've done that, I can go back to my terminal, clear the screen, make sure
cues.zh: 完成後回到終端機、清除畫面，確認

cues.en: I'm in my virtual environment, I am, and just type pip install-e dot, and that should go and get the necessary dependency for me.
cues.zh: 已在虛擬環境裡，沒錯。輸入 pip install -e .，應該會下載需要的相依套件。

cues.en: And there it goes, working away, and it's done, okay?
cues.zh: 開始安裝了，現在完成。

cues.en: So in the next lecture, we'll get started implementing a new store, okay?
cues.zh: 下一堂就會開始實作新的儲存區，

cues.en: And obviously, that's going to go over here in the stores directory.
cues.zh: 顯然會放在 stores 目錄，

cues.en: Like we have postgres.py, we'll put in a Weaviate.py and get started satisfying the necessary abstract interface contract, okay? Let's move on.
cues.zh: 就像 postgres.py 一樣，建立 weaviate.py，開始滿足必要的抽象介面契約。我們繼續。
